0.0: Let's see what happens when a human uses the Fairy's Horn Flute, I don't know how it'll react to humans using it, so there's no guarantee it'll work, but... do you still want to try it?

yes.0: All right, then go up to Moppie and play the Horn Flute in front of him. I don't know if the fairies will like the idea of a human playing it, though...

no.0: You took so much time and effort to acquire the horn flute, and now you don't want to help Moppie out? Are you really THAT afraid of the fairies?

yes.0: (When the horn flute starts to be played, a soothing sound echoes throughout the area while the horn flute disappears in a puff) Hey, it's... gone! Is that because I'm a human?
yes.1: Did I do all this for naught? \n#bHey can you hear me, bark bark?#k\n Hey, isn't this Moppie talking? It IS! I can clearly understand Moppie now!
yes.2: Okay, now I can understand what Moppie's saying! But... what??

npc.0: You still haven't used it? Don't be scared. Try it.
